articles.title: Iran Announces FULL BLOCKADE Of Hormuz After 4 Ships Targeted For Violating Tehran's Directives
articles.description: Iranian-linked reports say passage through the Strait of Hormuz has been completely halted for vessels accused of violating Tehran’s maritime rules, following fresh tanker attacks and the destruction of navigation systems. The escalation comes during a record month for attacks on commercial shipping in and around the strait, with dozens of vessels damaged since the conflict with Iran began. The IRGC Navy has claimed control over the strategic waterway and warned ships against using unauthorised routes.

Netanyahu Faces Mass Protests Ahead of Israel Election | Can Protests Turn Into Votes? News18
articles.description: Thousands of Israelis have taken to the streets of Tel Aviv to protest against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s government, just days before Israel’s October 27, 2026, general election. The protesters are demanding an independent state commission of inquiry into the security failures that preceded the October 7, 2023, Hamas-led attacks. Families of victims and former hostages have called for accountability, while opposition leaders have joined the demonstrations. Netanyahu has resisted calls for an independent inquiry, proposing a different investigative mechanism. Opposition parties have pledged to establish a state commission of inquiry if they take power. With public anger, political divisions and uncertainty over the formation of a governing majority, the election is being closely watched as a major test for Netanyahu’s leadership. articles.description: Iran has intensified its drone and missile attacks on Kurdish opposition groups based in Iraq’s Kurdistan Region, with the latest strike targeting a base belonging to the Komala of Revolutionary Toilers of Iranian Kurdistan in Erbil province. The group said an explosive-laden Shahed drone struck its base in the Alana Valley, in the Balisan area, causing material damage but no casualties. The attack follows a series of Iranian strikes on Kurdish opposition positions, including those belonging to the Kurdistan Freedom Party (PAK). The escalation comes despite a March 2023 security agreement between Baghdad and Tehran aimed at disarming Iranian Kurdish opposition groups and relocating them away from the shared border.
